content: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) models per-skill mastery as a latent binary variable in a hidden Markov model with learn/guess/slip/forget parameters, updated per attempt. Standard ITS technique for problem sequencing and mastery estimation. Needs enough attempts per skill per learner (or a pretrained population prior) to estimate parameters reliably -- built for classroom-scale data, not obviously well-suited to a single learner with no comparable population, unless parameters are hand-set/heuristic rather than fit from data.
